description: [Bollinger Band-Position Momentum Factor] The 5-session change in Bollinger %B, i.e. the change in the standardized distance of the close from the lower band over the last 5 trading sessions. It is NOT a scalar pctB level (which is just a rescaling of z20); it measures the velocity of movement within the fixed 20/2 band structure, capturing directional persistence or reversion after band excursions. Total historical lookback = 20 + 5 = 25 sessions, well within the 60-session cap. All inputs are adjusted closes observed through the current session only.
limitations: Implementation availability and historical checks do not establish profitable or stable out-of-sample returns.
Rolling windows require all observations (min_periods equals window); missing inputs and warmup rows remain missing.

adapter_validation.scope: Implementation parity only; no performance test, selection or profitability conclusion.
adapter_validation.causality_and_worker_checks: Run factor validate to record current-runtime contract checks separately.
